newsitem.title: USA: HORSE RACING-CIGAR EASILY WINS WOODWARD STAKES AT BELMONT.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-CIGAR EASILY WINS WOODWARD STAKES AT BELMONT.

text.p: Cigar bounced back from his surprising defeat at last month's Pacific Classic by coasting to a four-length victory on Saturday in the $500,000 Woodward Stakes at Belmont Racetrack.

Cigar, a 1-to-5 favourite, took the lead at the top of stretch under Jerry Bailey and won the prestigious 1-1/8-mile race in 1:47.06. The six-year-old Cigar has won 17 of his last 18 races, including three at Belmont during a record-tying 16-race winning streak.

Cigar paid $2.70, $2.10 and $2.10 for a $2 bet. L'Carrier, with Jorge Chavez in the saddle, returned $2.90 and $2.10 for his second-place finish and Golden Larch, with Rich Migliore aboard, paid $2.10. A late scratch reduced the field to five.

Cigar trailed by several lengths on the backstretch before beginning his charge on the outside on the final turn. L'Carrier and Golden Larch had jockeyed for the lead early in the race before Cigar took over.

Cigar was making his first start since losing to Dare And Go in California's Pacific Classic on August 10. The loss left Cigar tied with Citation for the North American record for consecutive victories.
"I think redemption is a good word," Bailey said. "I couldn't wait for today. Cigar couldn't wait for today."
Trainer Bill Mott was worried about the possibility of heavy rains, but the sun was shining at Belmont. Mott said he would have scratched Cigar if the track was sloppy.
In other races, Diplomatic Jet won the $400,000 Man of War, a 1 3/8-mile inner turf race. Yanks Music surprised Serena's Song to win the $250,000 Ruffian Handicap.
